description: Sin in a high-tech, ultra-lightweight bunny girl suit. On top of her already remarkable linguistic skills, she gains the ability to move at ultra-high speeds thanks to her suit. She joins the event as an anti-hero.

lines.text: Don't you think this outfit would look better without the converter?
Having trouble deciding where to look, Instructor?
Aren't I an exemplary prisoner? I've adjusted well, and I always do what I'm told.
I'll give you carrots instead of Splendamin from now on. Do you like carrots, Instructor?
If I give you enough luck, will you set me free?
You keep fiddling with my converter because you want to take it off for me, don't you? I can see right through you.
I'm bored... Are you sick of bunny girls already?
You used me up and now you're just going to abandon me? I even dressed up as a bunny girl just for you... That's a 50-point deduction!
There are a lot of bunny girls around here. Is this what you're into?
I'm glad I got rehabilitated. Now I get to be a bunny girl and go wherever I want!
Everyone here seems so well-behaved. Being too good all the time isn't always a good thing, though.
I heard you like bunny girls, Instructor. Fifty points to me for dressing up as one just for you!
Why are you being so nice to me? Do you need me to do something?
I feel like I've evolved into a super bunny girl! Hahaha!
Luck recharged!
You're giving me something this nice? Are you sure you're ready to handle the consequences, Instructor?
Should I give you a carrot in return?
Thanks! Guess I'll behave and listen to you for now.
Maybe I won't betray you after all.
I'll give you good luck, just for you, Instructor.
Since I'm feeling generous, 50 points to you for treating your bunny girl well!
What could a bunny girl possibly do?
I'm going.
Here comes the bunny!
Who knew bunny girls are this busy?
Here's some good luck for you.
I'll end this quick.
Looks easy enough.
Can you do it for me instead, Instructor?
Just a sec...
Bunnies have to do these things too?
With all my luck!
This is a piece of cake for a bunny girl like me!
That wasn't so hard, was it?
Okay, next!
That was too easy.
Bunny, bunny!
Ow! I got hit!
Ouch!
Ugh...
Hmph... there's no reasoning with them.
This bunny brought you good luck!
